subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this lineage shadow stage in the normal refreshed-scan path before the later safety and performance slices are landed?
rationale: The patch does not change authoritative totals, but it intentionally adds I/O and CPU work to a user-facing refresh path; accepting that intermediate availability profile and stack order requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Require exact-head proof first
options.body: Keep the PR open and require redacted cold, changed, unchanged-repeat, and cancellation evidence before reviewing the stack for ordered merge.

options.title: Accept staged overhead
options.body: Merge after the prerequisite while explicitly accepting temporary refresh overhead until the later safety and performance PRs land.

options.title: Consolidate the stack
options.body: Request a narrower integrated change that includes the safety and performance gates before routine shadow execution is introduced.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and require redacted cold, changed, unchanged-repeat, and cancellation evidence before reviewing the stack for ordered merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available decision owner for cost-scanner architecture and user-visible refresh overhead.
